mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_modified_hist')
INSERT INTO utb_modified_hist ( modified_hist_seq, tbl_seq, before_value, after_value, modified_content, note, office_seq, modified_date, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{modifiedHistSeq}, #{tblSeq}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{modifiedContent}, #{note}, #{officeSeq}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updateUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT h.modified_hist_seq AS modifiedHistSeq, h.tbl_seq AS tblSeq, h.before_value AS beforeValue, h.after_value AS afterValue, h.modified_content AS modifiedContent, h.note AS note, h.office_seq AS officeSeq, u.user_name_ko AS createUser, TO_CHAR(h.modified_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS modifiedDate FROM utb_modified_hist h LEFT JOIN utb_user_info u ON h.create_user = u.user_info_seq WHERE h.modified_hist_seq = #{modifiedHistSeq} AND h.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND h.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT h.modified_hist_seq AS modifiedHistSeq, h.tbl_seq AS tblSeq, h.before_value AS beforeValue, h.after_value AS afterValue, h.modified_content AS modifiedContent, h.note AS note, h.office_seq AS officeSeq, TO_CHAR(h.modified_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS modifiedDate, u.user_name_ko AS createUser /* VO의 createUser 필드에 이름 주입 */ FROM utb_modified_hist h LEFT JOIN utb_user_info u ON h.create_user = u.user_info_seq WHERE h.tbl_seq = #{request.tblSeq} AND h.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} AND h.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY h.create_at DESC
LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.offSet}
